chunks: It is not possible for all believers to go out (to fight). So a part of each section (of the population) should go (to fight) in order that the others may acquire understanding of law and divinity, and warn their companions on return so that they may take heed for themselves.

key_terms.لَعَلَّهُمْ يَحْذَرُونَ: so that they may take heed/be cautious

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on sending a specific group to learn religious knowledge while others fight?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, this verse is foundational for the institution of the 'Ulama', establishing the obligatory nature of deep jurisprudential study (Tafaqquh) as a communal duty (Fard al-Kifaya). It highlights the critical role of scholars as intermediaries who return to the community to convey divine warnings and guidance, thereby preserving the spiritual integrity of the Ummah.
